Ethan (AE): Quick. PrimeBank wants an evidence packet for POC: explicit admin console events, API key rotation events (before/after markers), emergency access toggles, and a verifiable 365-day immutability plan. They prefer Splunk but asked what options exist. Can we turn around in 48h?

Rae (SE): Yes. We'll produce a compact bundle (audit.jsonl), manifest.sha256, a PGP-signed manifest, and runbooks for Splunk HEC + Datadog + syslog over TLS. Hosted retention = 90d by default. To meet 365d: continuous forward to customer SIEM or periodic export to customer-owned S3 with object-lock=COMPLIANCE + customer KMS.

Noelle (Security): Requirements: include admin.ui.update_policy, admin.role.revoke, api.key.rotate (with old_key_id/new_key_id markers), emergency.access.enable/disable, and export.start/export.complete with operator and job_id. We'll redact PII by default and include a redaction appendix. We'll sign manifest with our security PGP key and include fingerprint in attestation.

Marcus (Risk): Vendor team also asked for chain-of-custody language: who initiated export, timestamp, artifact name, and signature verification steps. They want a short legal note about COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE object-lock semantics.

Rae (SE): Example lines we'll include in the bundle (redacted where applicable):

{"ts":"2027-01-15T18:02:10Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-5f3c2","range":"2027-01-01..2027-01-15"}
{"ts":"2027-01-15T18:04:01Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"api.key.rotate","old_key":"key-9a8b","new_key":"key-1c2d","result":"success"}
{"ts":"2027-01-15T18:05:33Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"admin.role.revoke","target":"team-ops"}
{"ts":"2027-01-15T18:06:22Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.complete","job_id":"job-5f3c2","artifact":"prime-poc-bundle-20270115.zip"}

Rae (SE): Splunk HEC sample (for the runbook):

curl -sS https://splunk.primebank.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2027-01-15T18:04:01Z","actor":"admin@primebank.com","action":"api.key.rotate","resource":"svc-ledger"}}'

Rae (SE): Datadog intake snippet (if they prefer):

curl -s -X POST "https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input/<API_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"message":"api.key.rotate actor=admin@primebank.com resource=svc-ledger ts=2027-01-15T18:04:01Z"}'

Noelle (Security): Manifest format example we will supply: one line per file: `<sha256>  filename` and we'll attach `manifest.sha256.sig`. Verification steps in runbook: `sha256sum -c manifest.sha256` then `gpg --verify manifest.sha256.sig manifest.sha256`. We'll include the PGP fingerprint and contact security@redwood.com.

Marcus (Risk): Please add a short paragraph explaining that COMPLIANCE object-lock prevents deletion or modification by any principal during retention and is the strongest WORM guarantee; GOVERNANCE allows certain principals to bypass and has less legal assurance. We'll reference AWS S3 docs and note equivalent semantics for other providers.

ShipBot: export job queued for 1855557777 - collecting events (range: 2027-01-01..2027-01-15) ETA ~50m

Ethan (AE): I'll tell PrimeBank we'll deliver bundle + signed manifest + runbook + attestation within 48h and offer a 30m verification walkthrough.

ShipBot: slice ready (1855557777/slice-2027-01-15.zip) - files: slice.jsonl (520KB), slice.sha256 - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1855557777/slice-2027-01-15.zip

Marcus (Risk): Received slice. I see api.key.rotate entries and operator job_id fields. We'll run the verification and revert with any legal follow-ups.

Noelle (Security): Drafting attestation: "Redwood Inference attests that the enclosed artifacts are exports from hosted tenant tn-PR1 covering 2027-01-01 to 2027-01-15. Fields marked REDACTED were masked per Redwood redaction policy v3.0. Manifest signed by security@redwood.com (PGP fingerprint: B3E1 9A4C 2F7D 88A1 5C2E  0D4B  6E9F 1C2A  4B3C 9F0D)." We'll attach attestation.pdf.

ShipBot: final bundle uploaded (1855557777/prime-poc-bundle-20270115.zip) - files: audit.jsonl (2.3MB), manifest.sha256, manifest.sha256.sig, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal.redwood/1855557777/prime-poc-bundle-20270115.zip

Ethan (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup: looping PrimeBank in and offering verification call now.

Rae (SE): FYI - we'll include a short script to verify chain-of-custody (hash + signature + list of operator events) in the runbook.
